Microsoft.Web.WebView2 SDK 1.0.3537.50, downloaded from the official NuGet flat-container endpoint.

WebView2.h and the x64 WebView2LoaderStatic.lib are the build inputs. LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt are supplied from that package. The installed Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime provides the actual browser. No Chromium runtime is bundled and no scripts are injected.
